findings.title: Write lock is taken without re-checking the cache
findings.body: In non-Dev mode, concurrent callers that all observe a nil cache under the read lock will queue on the write lock. After the first caller populates entryPointAssetsCache, each queued caller still re-reads and re-parses assets-manifest.json and replaces the cache because the non-nil check is not repeated after acquiring Lock. This serializes redundant file I/O under the exclusive lock during the initial request burst and blocks fast-path readers; re-check entryPointAssetsCache after Lock (for non-Dev) and return it if populated.

findings.title: No concurrent test covers the claimed race fix
findings.body: The change adds mutex synchronization around the package-global entryPointAssetsCache but adds no test exercising concurrent GetWebAssets calls (e.g. run with -race against a temporary assets-manifest.json). Without such a regression test, a future refactor that accesses the cache outside entryPointAssetsCacheMu would not be caught by CI.
